comment: Ladder of N rectangular bays: bottom points b0..bN, top points t0..tN. b0 fixed at the origin; bottom and top rails horizontal; rungs vertical; bay i width = 10 + (i % 3); rung 0 height 8; all rungs equal by construction of horizontal rails. Initial guess: exact solution perturbed deterministically by up to ±1.5 mm. Edit: bay 0 width 10 -> 12 (alternating). Expected: b_i = (sum widths, 0), t_i = (sum widths, 8).
